name: When should I call a plumber for a clogged toilet?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for a clogged toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber if your toilet remains clogged after using a plunger, if you experience frequent clogs, or if multiple drains in your home are slow or backed up. These issues might indicate a deeper problem in your plumbing system, such as a main sewer line blockage. A professional can diagnose and resolve complex clogs that household tools cannot handle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if plunging doesn't work, clogs are frequent, or multiple drains are affected, indicating a main line issue.
